definition: Impossible to understand or interpret with confidence.
author: Charlotte Brontë
quote: I still stood absolutely dumfoundered at what appeared to me her miraculous self-possession and most inscrutable hypocrisy, when the cook entered.
example_sentence: The cat gave me an inscrutable look and left the room.
